stages.title: The Field and Its Benchmark
stages.goal: What is CSP, and how does the community objectively measure progress?
stages.why_now: Before touching any method, you need the blind-test spine that frames every claim in the field and against which GAtor 2.0 will ultimately be measured.

items.why: See the origin of the objective CSP benchmark and the early lesson that generation could hit the target while ranking failed.
Understand the turning point where small rigid molecules became routinely solvable and the first cocrystal target appeared.
Read the largest, most comprehensive test documenting vdW-DFT, hierarchical workflows, and free-energy corrections becoming standard.

stages.gator_note: These tests define the success criteria and hard-case categories (Z'>1, multi-component, flexible) that GAtor 2.0 must eventually beat.

stages.title: The Most Recent Verdict
stages.goal: Where does the field stand right now on generation vs ranking, and how do MLIPs compare to periodic DFT-D?
stages.why_now: Completing the blind-test spine with the newest cycle before diving into methods gives you the current frontier lines directly.

items.why: Learn how the seventh test split out structure generation and added coordination complexes, PXRD-assisted CSP, and blind disorder prediction.
See the ranking half benchmark MLIPs against periodic DFT-D, directly relevant to GAtor's MLIP acceleration plans.
Get a synthesizing review that organizes the state of the art around the blind-test history.

stages.gator_note: Part 2's MLIP-vs-DFT-D benchmarking sets the accuracy bar for using MACE-OFF/AIMNet2/UMA inside GAtor 2.0's ranking ladder.

stages.title: The Marom-Group Backbone: Search Engines
stages.goal: How do GA and random-generation search engines produce candidate crystals, and where does the group's own line sit?
stages.why_now: Now that the benchmark is clear, study the generation stage and your own group's tools that GAtor 2.0 directly extends.

items.why: This is GAtor itself: read the molecular-crystal breeding operators and ML evolutionary niching you are rebuilding for 2.0.
Understand the MPI-parallel generator with ML volume estimation and special Wyckoff positions that seeds GAtor pools.
Compare GAtor's GA design against the canonical evolutionary CSP algorithm.
See the competing random-with-constraints philosophy that motivates Genarris-style generation.

stages.gator_note: This is the generation half of GAtor's generation/ranking junction: operators, niching, and Genarris seed pools are the core of 2.0.

stages.title: Generation Frontiers and Symmetry
stages.goal: How do generators handle close-packing, symmetry, and arbitrary Z'?
stages.why_now: Having the backbone, extend it with the newest generation methods and symmetric trial-structure tools relevant to Z'>1.

items.why: Read the Rigid Press close-packing and MACE-OFF/DFT clustering down-selection that bridges generation to MLIP screening.
Ground yourself in the Harris-approximation screening and relative-coordinate descriptor with affinity-propagation clustering.
See symmetric trial-structure generation with arbitrary Z' support directly useful for GAtor's Z'>1 goals.

stages.gator_note: Rigid Press and PyXtal's arbitrary-Z' generation feed directly into GAtor 2.0's push toward Z'>1 and multi-component seed pools.

stages.title: The Ranking Bottleneck: Dispersion-Inclusive DFT
stages.goal: How did the field reach the PBE0+MBD gold standard for ranking near-degenerate polymorphs?
stages.why_now: Generation feeds ranking; polymorphs differ by <1 kcal/mol, so this is the accuracy-limited stage GAtor's re-ranking ladder targets.

items.why: Learn the density-derived pairwise TS dispersion scheme that starts the accurate-ranking lineage.
Understand many-body dispersion, the key correction beyond pairwise for molecular crystals.
Study the hierarchical PBE0+MBD+F_vib protocol that recovered rank-1 experimental structures in blind test 6.
Survey the broader electronic-structure toolkit (periodic DFT/MP2, fragment methods, DMC) around the dispersion lineage.

stages.gator_note: PBE0+MBD is GAtor 2.0's accuracy target; the hierarchical protocol is the model for its dispersion-inclusive re-ranking ladder.

stages.title: Hard Systems: Z'>1, Salts, Cocrystals, Flexibility
stages.goal: Why do multi-component, high-Z', and flexible crystals defeat CSP, and how are they attacked?
stages.why_now: With generation and ranking mastered, confront the system classes that define GAtor 2.0's open frontiers.

items.why: Get the organizing framework for high-Z' crystals in relation to cocrystals and inclusion compounds.
See early connectivity-only search reaching Z'>1 and less-common space groups.
Study partial-information CSP where part of the cell is fixed, relevant to cocrystal-host and heavy-atom cases.
Understand anisotropic potentials applied to flexible pharmaceutical polymorphs like carbamazepine.

stages.gator_note: These define the multi-component and Z'>1 targets GAtor 2.0 aims to handle; EnvXGen's fixed-environment idea maps onto GAtor's operator design.

stages.title: Finite-Temperature Stability: From Lattice Energy to Free Energy
stages.goal: When and how does vibrational entropy re-rank polymorphs at experimental conditions?
stages.why_now: Static ranking is not the final answer; free energy is GAtor's frontier once generation and ranking are solid.

items.why: Quantify static-vs-vibrational energy differences and the ~21% enantiotropic re-ranking rate across 500+ pairs.
See MBD-phonon coupling break the lattice-energy degeneracy of aspirin forms I and II via entropy.
Study solid-solid free-energy differences with error bars under temperature and humidity, unifying anhydrate and hydrate landscapes.
Get the CSP_0/CSP_thd/CSP_aim framing of the gap between lattice-energy minimization and actionable prediction.

stages.gator_note: Free-energy re-ranking and MBD-phonon coupling define how GAtor 2.0's ranked landscapes must eventually become thermodynamically actionable.

stages.title: The ML Frontier: MLIP-Accelerated Pipelines
stages.goal: Can machine-learned potentials replace or accelerate the DFT stages end to end?
stages.why_now: Last, the current frontier: the MLIPs that will accelerate GAtor 2.0's relaxation and ranking, now that you know what accuracy they must match.

items.why: Learn the transferable short-range organic MLIP already used in Genarris 3.0 down-selection.
Study the hybrid short-range-ML plus long-range-physics model covering charged and element-organic chemistry.
See target-specific potentials trained on gas-phase n-mers transfer to crystalline environments in a blind test.
Examine an end-to-end workflow driven by a single universal MLIP (UMA) with OMC->OMol conformer correction, eliminating FF pre-screening and DFT re-ranking.
Understand Delta-ML correcting a DFTB baseline with cluster-trained ML as an alternative acceleration strategy.

stages.gator_note: MACE-OFF, AIMNet2, and UMA are exactly the potentials GAtor 2.0 will use to accelerate relaxation and ranking while targeting PBE0+MBD accuracy.

closing_note: This path walks the group's spine: blind tests set the benchmark, generation (GAtor/Genarris) and dispersion ranking form the Marom backbone, then hard systems and finite-T mark GAtor 2.0's open frontiers, with MLIPs as the accelerating endgame. Cross-reference beran-frontiers-2023, nyman-day-statistics-2015, day-review-2011, price-overprediction, hoja-mcsp-polymorphs, acm-molecular-crystals, neumann-tailormade-ff-2005, grace-angew-2008, blind-tests 2/3/5, and facts-fictions-polymorphism as you go deeper; karpathy_llm-wiki is off-topic for this curriculum.
